items.title: Infrastructure migrations, cleared for takeoff: AWS Transform and Outposts expand into AWS GovCloud (US)
items.summary: AWS Transform is now available in the AWS GovCloud (US-West) Region, so agencies and regulated organizations can plan and run large-scale migrations without leaving the AWS GovCloud (US) boundary designed for sensitive data and regulated workloads. From this region, you can target both AWS GovCloud (US-East) and AWS GovCloud (US-West) as migration destinations.
items.creator: Rodney Bozo
